new_categories.label: local_port_call_service_bundle_continuity
new_categories.memory: A port call can depend on a bundled local service layer whose continuity is distinct from berth, vessel and clearance readiness considered separately.

new_categories.label: local_port_information_freshness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence in current local service, access and coordination information can degrade separately from formal clearance/document readiness without retaining any port-specific instruction.

new_categories.label: service_order_dependency_chain_confidence
new_categories.memory: Local husbandry/supply services can depend on prerequisite service orders or confirmations; this dependency chain can be represented abstractly.

new_categories.label: funding_authorization_service_readiness_coupling
new_categories.memory: A local service may be physically available yet not ready because funding, authorization or appointment state is incomplete.

new_categories.label: local_service_substitution_depth_confidence
new_categories.memory: Continuity depends on whether equivalent local coverage can substitute when one service actor is unavailable, without naming vendors or ports.

new_categories.label: agent_service_scope_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: The scope between local agent coordination and specialist service-provider execution can be clear or uncertain without retaining agency-contract facts.

new_categories.label: service_bundle_partial_readiness
new_categories.memory: A port-call service bundle can be partially ready even if individual services report availability; bundled readiness is not a simple all-green state.

new_categories.label: local_service_change_notice_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that material local service changes have reached the vessel/manager can be represented separately from the service state itself.

new_categories.label: shore_launch_access_service_dependency
new_categories.memory: Some local service delivery depends on a shore/launch/access opportunity distinct from the underlying service-provider availability.

new_categories.label: supply_service_completion_confidence
new_categories.memory: Completion confidence for bounded husbandry or supply support is distinct from order placement and from vessel-side consumption or use.

new_categories.label: local_service_exception_ownership_confidence
new_categories.memory: A failed or delayed local service can have uncertain coordination ownership without proving legal or contractual responsibility.

new_categories.label: multi_stage_local_service_restoration
new_categories.memory: Provider availability, appointment, access, delivery/attendance, verification and release of resulting restrictions can restore at different times.

new_categories.label: local_service_margin_confidence
new_categories.memory: A port call may have little margin for late or missing local support even when nominal service coverage exists.

useful_refinements.label: local_service_bundle_vs_P008_administrative_readiness
useful_refinements.memory: P008 already owns agency, clearance, husbandry, disbursement and administrative readiness; P138 narrows to continuity and freshness of the private/regional local service bundle.

useful_refinements.label: local_service_bundle_vs_P137_ecosystem_topology
useful_refinements.memory: P137 owns broad institutional role/dependency topology; P138 tests the port-call-specific service bundle delivered through that topology.

useful_refinements.label: local_provider_support_vs_P067_equipment_service_network
useful_refinements.memory: P067 concerns equipment OEM/service lifecycle; P138 concerns local port-call husbandry/supply coordination, not equipment support.

useful_refinements.label: local_service_delay_not_root_cause_proof
useful_refinements.memory: Port-call delay, waiting or schedule effect does not prove which local service, agent or provider caused the problem.

duplicates.label: generic_administrative_service_readiness
duplicates.memory: Clearance, funding, appointment, service-order and administrative readiness substantially repeat P008.

duplicates.label: generic_ecosystem_availability_substitution_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic provider availability, substitution, scope, degradation and restoration repeat P137 and other service-state families.
